name: UGC 7636 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 7636, a dwarf irregular galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc7636-hubble
story: UGC 7636 is a dwarf irregular galaxy caught in a violent encounter with the giant elliptical galaxy NGC 4472. Tides first loosened its gas, then ram pressure swept it away into a cloud of hydrogen between the two galaxies, where young star clusters have formed.

claims.text: UGC 7636 is a dwarf irregular galaxy in the Virgo Cluster
UGC 7636 is interacting violently with the giant elliptical galaxy NGC 4472
Tides from NGC 4472 loosened UGC 7636's gas, and ram pressure stripping then removed it into an H I cloud between the galaxies
Young star clusters formed during the interaction, in the galaxy's center, its tidal tail and the H I cloud
UGC 7636 is a Virgo cluster dwarf in Hubble program 17240, which targets dwarfs undergoing ram pressure stripping
